# devzero_team (Resource)

A team started from the provider's team, such as a partner's team for one of its customers. Creating it starts the team in DevZero with the provider's `team_id` as the starting team, which must be a DevZero partner team.

Drive this resource with a service account's token (`dzs-`), not a person's. Destroying it is the token owner's leave of the team: with a service account's token the team, its people and its clusters stay. With a person's token the destroy is that person's leave, and when they are the team's last member it deletes the team.

The values the team is started with are not managed afterwards: the team's Admins rename it and manage its people in DevZero, and a changed `name`, `member_emails` or `admin_invite_emails` is refused. If the team can no longer be read (it was deleted, or the token's owner was removed from it), refresh fails rather than starting a new team.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A partner onboards a customer: it starts the customer's team from its own
# team and registers the customer's cluster in it. The provider runs as the
# partner's team, with a service account's token kept in the partner's
# secret store.
variable "partner_team_id" {
  type = string
}

variable "partner_service_account_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

provider "devzero" {
  url     = "https://dakr.devzero.io"
  team_id = var.partner_team_id
  token   = var.partner_service_account_token
}

# The people named in member_emails join in the role they hold in the
# partner's team, and one of them must be an Admin there. The customer's
# admin is invited as Admin and joins when they accept the invite.
resource "devzero_team" "acme" {
  name                = "Acme"
  member_emails       = ["alice@partner.example"]
  admin_invite_emails = ["admin@acme.example"]
}

# Register the customer's cluster in the new team. Its token is the one
# DevZero's agents in that cluster report with.
resource "devzero_cluster" "acme_prod" {
  name    = "acme-prod"
  team_id = devzero_team.acme.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the team when it is started. A rename by the team's Admins shows no drift; a change here is refused.

### Optional

- `admin_invite_emails` (Set of String) Addresses invited as Admin of the new team when it is started, such as the customer's admin. A person already in the provider's team is named in `member_emails` instead. Used only when the team is started: a change is refused; send further invites from the team's Settings > Members.
- `member_emails` (Set of String) People of the provider's team, by email, who join the new team, each in the role they hold in the provider's team (Admin or Developer). At least one person must join as Admin, so with a service account's token name an Admin here. Used only when the team is started: a change is refused; manage the team's people in its Settings > Members.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the team
- `invites_not_sent` (Set of String) Addresses from `admin_invite_emails` whose invite was saved but whose email DevZero could not send. Re-send them from the team's Settings > Members.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import devzero_team.acme <team_id>
```
